description: Erection of a two storey side extension, part single, part two storey rear extension and a front porch
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (0128-EX-00 Rev A, 0128-EX-10 Rev A, 0128-EX-20 Rev A, received on 04/11/2021; First Statement (Rev A), received on 29/11/2021; 0128-PR-10 Rev C1 & 0128-PR-20 Rev C1, received on 13/01/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 5 - No part of the development (including any guttering) shall overhang land outside of the ownership of the owner of the application property.
